findings: The layer predicate k<distance-floor and truncated layer potential use the same fixed important-demand set and immutable endpoint floor. Edge addition makes both terms antitone.

The one-step layer identity is exact for every natural excess, including zero and the boundary k=excess. Componentwise monotonicity justifies distributing truncated subtraction in the two-term marginal split.
The raw/excess marginal identity is the existing exact cancellation of the same endpoint-floor sum; it does not change the greedy objective.

Telescoping through card(I) is exhaustive because every normalized chain distance is bounded by card(I); the residual layer potential is exactly zero. Thus all actual raw savings equal the sum of nested layer-cardinality depletions.
limits: No theorem asserts independent greedy optimality of individual layers.
